summary_en: This work demonstrates high-fidelity acoustic holography across a water-air interface using a passive, subwavelength acoustic meta-projector. A full-mode expansion model identifies a quasi-decoupled operating point that breaks the usual amplitude-phase locking of anti-reflection structures, enabling joint and effectively independent control of transmitted acoustic amplitude and phase. Numerical and experimental results reconstruct prescribed airborne patterns from an underwater incident wave, and the authors further demonstrate potential for contactless cross-media particle assembly.

summary_en: This review surveys digital acousto-optic holography, in which ultrasonic excitation is measured through full-field, non-contact optical holography to image defects inside opaque solids. It compares television-holography displacement measurements with digital-shearography strain-gradient measurements, explains numerical propagation of the measured complex surface field into the material volume, and assesses trade-offs in sensitivity, fringe visibility, robustness, and depth resolution. It also summarizes recent progress in high-speed acquisition, multi-wavelength deformation measurement, and dual-mode architectures.
